title: Bundle response v1
description: Body of GET /v1/bundles/active. signature = base64(Ed25519(canonical_json(bundle))) under key_id. override is unsigned and can only reduce enforcement.

signature.description: Standard base64 (RFC 4648 section 4, padded) of the 64-byte Ed25519 signature.

override.description: Emergency downgrade. The SDK obeys "shadow" because it can only reduce enforcement.
